tasks.title: Freeze the actual starting tree and existing work
steps: Record HEAD, rustc/cargo versions, Cargo.lock SHA256, feature graph, CPU/RAM/free disk, and hashes of all relevant dirty/untracked sources.
Group existing local changes by owner/provenance. Create an isolated task branch only after preserving them; do not reset or stash another person’s work.
Record exact selected upstream revisions and all 29 issue numbers in the plan evidence; refresh issue state before proposing any closure.
acceptance: The baseline identifies both committed and uncommitted inputs; another worker can tell precisely which tree was tested.
No credential files, raw environment values, private keys or chat histories enter the manifest.

acceptance: secure_128 and secure_128_deep resolve to identical current tuples.

Exact product width is used, not summed lane bit widths.

NIST input generation via secrets.randbelow is explicitly distinguished from actual NTT traces.

Retire the monograph MRS-emission paragraph as a current design instruction. Specify observation separately: adjacent subtraction returns K for the existing pair; any representation where it directly returns the requested value needs its own equation.
Specify general division output semantics and which actual operator domains are reversible. Record remaining unknowns rather than declaring every arithmetic operation bijective.
Map magnitude, sign, division and disambiguation to the actual proof coordinates. Use A > floor(X_max/M) for an inclusive maximum; never infer magnitude or hidden phase from a bare shadow residue.

A worker can distinguish priming root, independent carrier, dependent sister view, public projection and encrypted phase without inferring meaning from a variable named prime.
No hidden scalar K, loss of lane2/11, MRS hot-path fallback or assumed infinite capacity is permitted.

tasks.title: Evaluate the bounded canonical digit under encryption
steps: Load/construct only the validated R02 schedule bound to the selected parameter/circuit fingerprint.
Evaluate h+F(x-h) in the high encoding; issue CanonicalLowDigitLift through a private constructor only after public admission and lineage checks.
Run the same operations and bounds declared in the schedule, using B03 slot transforms where specified.

Keep evidence fields private. Use a child producer module of prime_power_phase, as the existing digit_lift module does, or an equally restricted producer interface; do not expose an arbitrary public certificate constructor. Re-export only the checked evaluator API.
acceptance: For all admitted toy x, decrypted output is the canonical r in [0,p), not merely a value equal modulo p.
Noise bound holds at each node; corrupted schedule, family or source bound refuses.
Native p=65537 vectors pass with nonzero noise and no secret/digit oracle in evaluator code.
tasks.stop: Do not manufacture CanonicalLowDigitLift from the low-view ciphertext, a clear residue or a test-only oracle.
tasks.patch_policy: One concern per patch; split before exceeding 400 changed production lines. Preserve this task acceptance contract across subpatches.

tasks.title: Contract and return to the work-key domain
steps: Reuse conditional contraction with the real B05 lift and include its scale/error terms.
Implement the reviewed boot→work switch and any final transform/basis transition in the exact order frozen by R03.
Return a main-only work-key ciphertext with a valid C02 output bound and restored next-operation capacity.
acceptance: Correct full-polynomial plaintext and work-key identity survive contraction/return.
A subsequent exact multiply decrypts correctly and its predicted bound remains within the next refresh input allowance.
Wrong low-digit encoding or destination key refuses.
tasks.stop: Key switching alone does not change the plaintext encoding. Do not reset the output bound to fresh-encryption cost without a derivation.
tasks.patch_policy: One concern per patch; split before exceeding 400 changed production lines. Preserve this task acceptance contract across subpatches.

tasks.title: Assemble an admitted native public refresh backend
steps: Add PublicRefreshPlan/PublicRefreshKeys/PublicRefreshEvaluator interfaces using the complete reviewed pipeline.
Validate complete plan and resource certificates before key generation; validate actual input certificate before evaluation.
Keep legacy public_phase1_soundness_gate for the invalid old implementation. Route only explicitly admitted new plans to the new backend.
acceptance: Public evaluator compiles and runs without client secret objects or plaintext helpers.
Fresh, added, multiplied and relinearized full-polynomial cases refresh correctly at every admitted input level.
Unsupported tuple/level/certificate/resource inputs return typed errors.
tasks.stop: Do not delete the old gate to make tests reach code. A new backend is admitted only by its own complete certificates.
tasks.patch_policy: One concern per patch; split before exceeding 400 changed production lines. Preserve this task acceptance contract across subpatches.

tasks.title: Make refresh automatic using predicted input and operation bounds
steps: Preflight both operands against the planned operation and the refresh backend’s input margin; refresh early enough that the input is still admissible.
For a shared operand squared, refresh at most once. Preserve branch history and avoid recursive refresh loops.
Use ExactMulEvaluator after preflight. Update counters only after success; return typed failure if refresh cannot provide the next-operation capacity.
acceptance: Deterministic tests exercise no-refresh, left-only, right-only, both and shared-operand cases.
Refresh failure leaves caller operands unchanged; counters never report a failed refresh as successful.
A long chain needs no manual refresh request and records actual refresh calls.
tasks.stop: Do not lower thresholds until a failing chain happens to pass or infer capacity from operation count alone.
tasks.patch_policy: One concern per patch; split before exceeding 400 changed production lines. Preserve this task acceptance contract across subpatches.

tasks.title: Prove repeated public refresh acceptance and failure boundaries
steps: Run an independent all-coefficient oracle through encrypt/add/two squares, then at least three refresh→multiply cycles on each admitted production tuple/level; extend soak runs separately.
Cover 0,1,t-1, centered boundaries, dense/sparse/nonconstant plaintexts, random keys and supported worst-case error fixtures. Fork and rejoin computation DAGs.
Assert typed refusal outside the certified domain and test corrupted lineage/lift/key/circuit metadata. Record RNG, feature, tuple, route, toolchain and source identifiers.
acceptance: Every step checks actual plaintext; no test can pass by printing a mismatch or counting depth.
The runtime path has no secret access and the final ciphertext supports another admitted operation.
Functional trials supplement, not replace, the noise/parameter proof gates.
tasks.stop: A single wrong accepted plaintext blocks M2. Do not relabel the case unsupported unless the original public admission predicate already excluded it.
tasks.patch_policy: One concern per patch; split before exceeding 400 changed production lines. Preserve this task acceptance contract across subpatches.

tasks.title: Capture real Shadow-source traces and their provenance
steps: Instrument an isolated off-path research probe for the actual shadow operations; record operation/lane/twiddle/source classification, seed provenance and sampling protocol.
Test fixed public inputs, attacker-chosen inputs, actual ciphertext workloads and independently randomized private inputs as distinct populations.

Export synthetic/non-secret trace datasets for the historical NIST harness and an independent statistical implementation; do not export production keys, secret-dependent raw shadows or user plaintexts.
acceptance: The NIST input is demonstrably the recorded Rust trace rather than secrets.randbelow output substituted upstream.
Twiddle-one, zero-input, repeat-input and cross-lane correlations are explicitly measured.
Turning capture on/off produces bit-identical primary arithmetic outputs.
tasks.stop: Do not wire research trace buffers into production logging or seed a key directly from an unreviewed trace.
tasks.patch_policy: One concern per patch; split before exceeding 400 changed production lines. Preserve this task acceptance contract across subpatches.

tasks.title: Establish the source-to-adversary entropy bridge
steps: Specify exactly which source variables remain unknown under each physical/profile view, including public operands, key leakage, accumulator state and prior outputs.
Prove/check the actual quotient/carry transform and its conditional distribution. Uniform full-product V is not assumed for an NTT product without justification.
Replace only the needed placeholder theorems with substantive statements and an implementation correspondence; account for dependence, chosen inputs and state compromise.
Assign zero additional secret-entropy credit to deterministic functions of fully public inputs. Any positive credit must have explicit entropy assumptions and extraction loss.

Use Round I T14 to quantify information loss conditional on the observed projection. Establish when a harvested complementary coordinate retains entropy conditioned on the entire attacker view; do not substitute H(input|output) for that actual source model.
acceptance: Exact propositions, axiom report and small-domain distribution oracle agree.
State compromise/repeated input/public-input cases cannot be mislabeled independent entropy.
The contract either supports a precisely scoped source claim or records its unresolved hypothesis.
tasks.stop: Statistical tests cannot certify unpredictability or independence. A theorem concluding True cannot discharge this task.
tasks.patch_policy: One concern per patch; split before exceeding 400 changed production lines. Preserve this task acceptance contract across subpatches.

tasks.title: Freeze the Three Locks protocol and interruption threat model
steps: Specify every state transition, actual key/mask storage region, recoverable attacker view, restart behavior and exact security claim for P1/P2/P3.
Specify an independently seeded baseline and a reviewed conditioner/domain separation for shadow supplemental input. Model related layers and compromise; do not add nominal bit strengths.

Choose a reviewed lossless outer encoding or explicitly bound outer RLWE noise before full-polynomial inner decoding. Specify integrity/fault response rather than assuming malleable encryption authenticates.
Draw the key-access boundary: local secret-holder refresh does not become public homomorphic refresh by wrapping it. A full snapshot containing all secrets/shares fails the profile.
acceptance: A specialist reviews a concrete protocol before implementation; every claimed inaccessible asset has an enforceable deployment mechanism.
No claim assumes destructors on power loss or source variables always occupying registers.
The chosen protocol supports all coefficients or explicitly declares its restricted message domain.
tasks.stop: Do not implement an improvised outer cipher/combiner or promise EMP resistance from software-only evidence. If the desired profile cannot be met, return a concrete isolation requirement.
tasks.patch_policy: One concern per patch; split before exceeding 400 changed production lines. Preserve this task acceptance contract across subpatches.

tasks.title: Implement the reviewed Shadow Lock and key/mask lifecycle
steps: Implement the exact H02 state machine and key-provider interfaces with independent keys and domain-separated epoch/counter context.
Condition shadow input as specified; preserve the secure baseline if shadow capture is absent/repeated or its source contract fails.
Remove unsupported secret-key clones/debug/serialization, control buffers and copies, and enforce zeroization for normal and error paths without claiming power-loss cleanup.
Keep Three Locks deployment code separate from the public refresh evaluator and record real outer-noise costs.
acceptance: Correct data recovers with the right keys; wrong/replayed/corrupted envelope, key and epoch cases follow H02 refusal policy.
Primary ciphertext computation is unaffected by harvesting; every buffer ownership/lifetime edge matches the protocol.
No plaintext/key/mask material enters diagnostics or wire metadata.
tasks.stop: If source contracts or isolation assumptions are unavailable, keep this an experimental profile and do not advertise physical protection.
tasks.patch_policy: One concern per patch; split before exceeding 400 changed production lines. Preserve this task acceptance contract across subpatches.

tasks.title: Test interruption at each sensitive transition
steps: Use synthetic secrets in a test harness with hooks before/after each state transition; attempt recovery from exactly the memory/bus view allowed by the profile.
Include abrupt process termination, panic/abort, restart, duplicate RNG state, retained mask/key copies and compiler-generated spills. Capture optimized assembly and memory maps.
Arrange separate hardware-lab tests for a P3 power/EM claim; record hardware, access, trigger and recovery procedure. Software simulation does not substitute.
acceptance: Every recovery attempt has a reproducible success/failure result and defined attacker view.
A snapshot containing a key or all shares must demonstrate the expected failure and cannot be omitted.
Any advertised protection is scoped to a passed profile and deployment build.
tasks.stop: Do not emit real secrets in artifacts or perform physical fault injection against live hardware/user data. Hardware claims remain unverified until the lab evidence exists.
tasks.patch_policy: One concern per patch; split before exceeding 400 changed production lines. Preserve this task acceptance contract across subpatches.

tasks.title: Use GSO to optimize certified plans rather than reset noise counters
steps: Implement an offline/public-metadata candidate search over approved tuples, transform layouts, gadget sizes, schedules and refresh placement.
Validate every candidate with the same independent capacity/error/security-input validators used by exhaustive search; objective values use actual public operation costs.
Retain the old collapse mechanism as historical unless a real ciphertext transformation is separately proved. Compare against a deterministic exhaustive baseline.
acceptance: Optimizer output changes an executable plan or schedule, never merely a remaining-noise counter.
An invalid candidate selected by the swarm is rejected independently.
Report candidate counts, exact winners and replay seed; no secret-dependent optimization telemetry.
tasks.stop: Do not treat a swarm convergence counter as a BFV noise-reduction proof or use observed hidden errors in public scheduling.
tasks.patch_policy: One concern per patch; split before exceeding 400 changed production lines. Preserve this task acceptance contract across subpatches.

tasks.title: Produce exact parameter and evaluation-key security inputs
steps: Define a reusable exact-instance exporter for N,Q,t, secret/error distributions, samples, sparse keys, gadget/evaluation-key relations and targeted classical/quantum attack models.
Pin an external estimator revision and archive raw input/output for current tuples and R03 candidate requests. Explain unsupported estimators/assumptions rather than synthesizing a label.
Resolve secure_256’s 240-bit in-tree binding versus its name, custom/for_depth unchecked labels, and legacy full-Q bootstrap sampling with real source tests.
Require specialist review for key cycles, sparse temporary secrets and compositions outside estimator coverage.
acceptance: Every advertised security label maps to exact sampler/runtime parameters and archived estimator evidence.
Uniform full-Q samplers cover all declared RNS lanes; no u64/u128 mask stands in for a larger product.
Estimator success alone is not described as a complete cryptographic proof.
tasks.stop: Do not reduce declared security, omit sparse-key samples or treat two encryption layers as additive security bits without an explicit reviewed decision.
tasks.patch_policy: One concern per patch; split before exceeding 400 changed production lines. Preserve this task acceptance contract across subpatches.

tasks.title: Close constant-time boundaries for the selected runtime
steps: Map secret-bearing vs public-ciphertext paths and all data-dependent branches, integer division, table indices, allocations and cache behavior on the selected route.
Review F-2/F-3 reachability after migration; a bypass must be structural and tested, not a renamed finding. Any capacity-changing replacement re-enters parameter tests.
Run disassembly review and reproducible timing/cache tests on named CPU/compiler builds; include new wide arithmetic and H03 if claimed.
Accept this task only on the integrated refresh and Shadow Lock source hashes. Early CRAM-only measurements are a baseline, not approval for subsequently added paths.
acceptance: Each sensitive path has an explicit result and evidence, with known variable-time verification-only paths labeled.
No all-observable/no-side-channel claim is inferred from source-level branchlessness or a single t-test.
tasks.stop: A timing result is architecture-specific. Do not call a branch constant-time solely because the compiler might lower it to cmov.
tasks.patch_policy: One concern per patch; split before exceeding 400 changed production lines. Preserve this task acceptance contract across subpatches.

tasks.title: Connect formal statements to implemented kernels and bounds
steps: Prove the exact arithmetic identities and bound recurrences actually used by the selected kernels; map Rust preconditions to theorem hypotheses.
Ensure the root build imports every claimed module and produce #print axioms output for release theorems.
Keep cryptographic hardness assumptions explicit; mark stale Coq/prototype statements by exact proposition instead of accepting README counts.

Map the monograph instruction-set claim to actual Lean/Coq propositions, including K-free adjacent recovery, arbitrary-target projection and admitted operator domains. Record builds and axiom dependencies; do not equate a K-elimination lemma with verification of the entire ISA.
acceptance: Pinned Lean build succeeds for every claimed module; no True/sorry/axiom shortcut supplies an implementation correctness result.
The theorem’s rounding/sign/basis conventions match Rust and independent oracle fixtures.
tasks.stop: Do not fix a difficult proof by weakening its statement or adding an axiom; report the unresolved obligation.
tasks.patch_policy: One concern per patch; split before exceeding 400 changed production lines. Preserve this task acceptance contract across subpatches.

tasks.title: Make CI enforce target coverage and production features
steps: Wire resource-classed jobs for exact arithmetic, integration/wire/service, refresh when admitted, bindings, no-float and formal checks; retain full --no-fail-fast coverage.
Build production artifacts in a separate feature graph so a test dev-dependency cannot unify allow_insecure into a release artifact.
Reject missing artifacts, zero-test jobs and stale source hashes. Prepare owner-only hosted Actions/billing/ruleset requirements as a concrete checklist.
acceptance: Local commands and hosted jobs run the same declared targets and archive their counts/exits.
A deliberately removed acceptance target or added allow_insecure dependency makes the manifest gate fail.
Hosted required-check activation is evidenced before release, not assumed from a YAML file.
tasks.stop: Do not change account settings, branch rules or billing from this task. Request owner action only with the finished concrete configuration.
tasks.patch_policy: One concern per patch; split before exceeding 400 changed production lines. Preserve this task acceptance contract across subpatches.

tasks.title: Measure complete CRAM and refresh costs on fixed workloads
steps: Demonstrate separate evaluator/client roles, exact sign/capacity behavior, lane operations, main-only multiply, auto-refresh cycles and typed refusal with real route ledger output.
Run at least three same-machine release measurements with fresh keys, recording median/p95, keygen, per-stage refresh cost, memory/key bytes and amortized cost per supported operation.
Compare old/new routes only under identical tuples/compiler/workloads and verify every timed output. Include scalar and packed full-polynomial workloads.
Show refresh frequency and latency explicitly; automatic operation removes manual intervention but does not imply zero computational cost.

Benchmark preserved-root frame reconfiguration and heterogeneous/homogeneous tray execution, including transient memory, actual synchronization stages, observation cost and serial/parallel scaling. Hardware single-cycle claims require named hardware evidence.
acceptance: Every plotted/table number has a raw artifact and source/tuple/route hash.
Refused operations and correctness failures cannot become benchmark successes.
The showcase clearly distinguishes M1/M2/M3 capability status.
tasks.stop: Do not quote the historical depth-50/200 or speed figures unless F03/V04 actually reproduce their exact workload.
tasks.patch_policy: One concern per patch; split before exceeding 400 changed production lines. Preserve this task acceptance contract across subpatches.

tasks.title: Assemble release evidence and reconcile every open issue
steps: Generate a manifest joining source hashes, tuples, capability flags, tests, proof/estimator artifacts, physical profiles, performance and issue acceptance criteria.
Mark each issue reproduced/fixed/verified/partially satisfied/external/unsupported with evidence; issue closure is a later owner-authorized action.
Rewrite current-facing claims around the final implemented behavior, keeping history intact and eliminating admitted-vs-working ambiguity.
Prepare reviewable release/package/deployment instructions and remaining owner actions; do not publish automatically.
acceptance: M2 remains incomplete unless every public-refresh gate passed; M3 claims require the named passed physical profile.
A clean independent reproduction can rebuild artifacts and verify claims from the pinned manifest.
No model self-assessment, stale README number or missing check is accepted as release evidence.
tasks.stop: A blocked research/physical gate cannot be reported as complete. A narrower intermediate release requires an explicit scope statement.
tasks.patch_policy: One concern per patch; split before exceeding 400 changed production lines. Preserve this task acceptance contract across subpatches.
